svg.title: Supplier–Buyer Agent Collaboration connectivity
svg.desc: The four numbered runtime stages followed by separate private service attachments, delegated token exchange, restricted publication, and optional operator VPN.

text.tspan: Private Foundry + Copilot Studio A2A | Network, identity, and operator paths separated
Verifies guest, uses its own app identity
ACR registry and data endpoint zone
Private names resolve to PE addresses
Nine baseline zones, listed in the guide
ADDITIONAL PRIVATE-ENDPOINT ATTACHMENTS / SAME PE SUBNET
IDENTITY EXCHANGE / SUPPLEMENTS STAGE 3, NOT A SECOND BUSINESS ROUTE
Returns to the numbered A2A route
OPERATOR AND DEPLOYMENT / SEPARATE FROM THE RUNTIME REQUEST
Not required for the main runtime
Scoped private DNS for the operator
No site-to-site AWS–Azure tunnel. NSGs and outbound policies are deployment-owned. The HTTP-only baseline has no Queue/Table endpoints.
Logical product labels only. Responses return through the same chain. Azure private access does not make Copilot Studio or Entra private.
